scope: fafstmobel's DFlash2 drafter projections stored as Q4 instead of Q8 (official qwen3_8_27b_nvfp4 recipe; the fused QKV projection and its shared context key/value projections keep Q8, their only native form). Only drafter proposals change; target verification is exact, so the output distribution is the target's. All target, vision, MTP and proposal-head objects are byte-identical to the published artifact.
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 32 GB; desktop GPU clients active (the Omarchy fullscreen screensaver and compositor held 21-34% of SM time during the serving run), so wall-clock tok/s here is not comparable with earlier records

model.published: satellitedown/fafstmobel 879903480d257762989d05785ee7d8935074703f: this Q4-drafter conversion, fafstmobel.ninfer, 22,884,131,844 bytes. Baseline: revision 54202e174c5f05945fbb873d1c2d8384e2643bd3, 23,719,715,844 bytes, drafter projections Q8
model.q4_drafter: same sources converted with the updated official recipe; 22,883,654,212 payload bytes; 16 of 1246 objects differ (dflash2 feature projection and each layer's attention output, MLP down and MLP gate/up)

drafter_kernels.method: nsys with graph-node tracing, ninfer_bench bench corpus pp8192+tg128, path verification, K=15, optimized proposal head, K8V4; per call-site median durations summed per round (robust to desktop time slicing)
drafter_kernels.note: Q8 per-call values for MLP down, attention output and feature projection are read from the mixed grid-320 kernel group of the Q8 profile.

acceptance.method: ninfer-serve with --verify-tree, 32768 context, K8V4, no prefix reuse; 16 coding tasks x seeds 1 and 2, thinking with reasoning effort medium, model default sampling (T=1, top-k 20, top-p 0.95), 1024 output tokens per request (profiles/exp/sample_accept.py)

capacity.profile: installer profile: 262144 context and KV, K8V4, DFlash2 K=15 with optimized head and verify trees, vision, 2 host state slots, 1 GiB host KV; desktop holding 1.48 GiB of VRAM
capacity.q8_drafter: fails: runtime reservation needs 8,608,179,713 bytes, 8,333,295,616 available; weights 21.7 GiB
capacity.q4_drafter: starts: weights 20.9 GiB, 993.2 MiB free after startup

qualification: linear_dynamic_grouped_conv_add oracle test over Q8 and Q4 projections, C=4096/17408, W=2..16, B=1..8, eager and graph replay
Q4 Linear conformance including 5120x25600 across GEMV, K-split capacities, row-split MMA and the prefill route
Q4 LinearSwiGLU conformance with two row tiles per small-T CTA
ninfer_qwen3_5_dflash2_real_test on the Q4-drafter artifact: K=15 chain and tree at B=1 and B=8 graph (B=8 with vision) and B=2 eager

context_sweep.method: ninfer_bench, 262144-token corpus, verify trees with prompt lookup, greedy, 256 generated tokens, Q8 and Q4 drafter artifacts alternating for 5 rounds; the Omarchy screensaver held ~23% of SM time throughout, so absolute times are inflated and the round-time ratio is the controlled metric
context_sweep.note: Tokens per round of a single 256-token trajectory differ by about one round between drafters (8K 13.47 vs 12.80, 32K 14.22 vs 13.47, 131K 14.22 vs 14.22); see high_acceptance for an aggregate.

high_acceptance.method: ninfer_bench, 262144-token corpus, verify trees, greedy, 512 generated tokens after 4K, 8K, ..., 32K-token prompts (8 trajectories per drafter)

greedy_equivalence: BF16 KV, DFlash2 K=15, 6 prompts x 256 greedy tokens: the Q4 and Q8 drafters emit identical token IDs on all prompts.

kv_cache_perplexity.method: ninfer-perplexity on the Q4-drafter artifact (text weights identical to the Q8-drafter artifact), ninfer-ppl-1m-v1 quick corpus, context 65536, stride 32768, 261,167 scored tokens, same build and corpus for every KV representation
kv_cache_perplexity.note: K8V4, which --verify-tree requires, scores within 0.08% of BF16 KV and no worse than fp8 KV on this corpus.
